```{r import DEPs for Pap1}
#wd = "/Users/usri/Desktop/GO.Kv1.3.Proteomics"
library(readr)
ANOVA_diffEx_PAP1_VS_CONTROL <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Venn.snRNAseq.MICROGLIA.PAP1.SHK/GO.Bulk.Proteomics.KV1.3/ANOVA_diffEx-PAP1.VS.CONTROL.csv")

table(ANOVA_diffEx_PAP1_VS_CONTROL$Significant)

PAP1.VS.CONTROL.UP <- subset(ANOVA_diffEx_PAP1_VS_CONTROL, Significant=="UP")
saveRDS(PAP1.VS.CONTROL.UP, file = 'PAP1.VS.CONTROL.UP.rds')

PAP1.VS.CONTROL.DOWN <- subset(ANOVA_diffEx_PAP1_VS_CONTROL, Significant=="DOWN")
saveRDS(PAP1.VS.CONTROL.DOWN, file = 'PAP1.VS.CONTROL.DOWN.rds')

Background <- ANOVA_diffEx_PAP1_VS_CONTROL$Protein
saveRDS(Background, file = 'KV1.3.Proteomics.Background.rds')
```



```{r GO for PAP1 vs. Control UP}
# Step 2: Run GO enrichment using SYMBOLs directly
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
GO <- enrichGO(
    gene = PAP1.VS.CONTROL.UP$Protein,
    universe = Background,
    OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
    keyType = "SYMBOL",       # <- SYMBOL not Symbol
    ont = "ALL",              # BP, MF, CC
    #pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    #qvalueCutoff = 1,         # No filtering yet
    readable = FALSE          # Already using SYMBOLs, so no need to convert
)

# Step 3: Check if SYMBOLs are in the result
head(GO@result[, c("ID", "Description", "p.adjust", "geneID")], 5)
# Step 3: Add z-score calculation function
add_zscore <- function(go_data, label) {
    go_data@result %>%
        filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
        mutate(
            Group = label,
            Observed = as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", GeneRatio)),
            GeneTotal = as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", GeneRatio)),
            BgTotal = as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", BgRatio)),
            BgObserved = as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", BgRatio)),
            zscore = (Observed / GeneTotal - BgObserved / BgTotal) / sqrt(Count)
        )
}

GO.df <- add_zscore(GO, "UP.PAP1.vs.Control")

# Step 4: Add -log10(p.adjust)
GO.df$neg.log10.Padjust <- -log10(GO.df$p.adjust)

#write.csv(GO.df, file = 'GO.df.UP.PAP1.vs.Control.csv')

# Step 5: Extract top 15 GO terms by significance
top_go_up <- GO.df %>%
    arrange(desc(neg.log10.Padjust)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 15)

# Prepare data for plotting
top_go_up$Description <- factor(top_go_up$Description, levels = top_go_up$Description[order(top_go_up$Count)])

# Step 6: Plot
ggplot(top_go_up, aes(x = Count, y = Description, fill = neg.log10.Padjust)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "brown", name = "-log10(p.adjust)") +
    labs(
        title = "GO: UP.PAP1 vs Control",
        x = "Gene Count",
        y = "GO Term"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )
```

```{r venn}
# Install if needed

library(eulerr)

# Clean input sets (remove NAs)
#set1 <- unique(na.omit(ShK.vs.PBS.DOWN$Protein))
#set2 <- unique(na.omit(ShK.vs.PBS.UP$Protein))
#set3 <- unique(na.omit(PAP1.VS.CONTROL.DOWN$Protein))
#set4 <- unique(na.omit(PAP1.VS.CONTROL.UP$Protein))


# Clean input sets (remove NAs)
set1 <- unique(na.omit(ShK.vs.PBS.DOWN$Protein))
set2 <- unique(na.omit(ShK.vs.PBS.UP$Protein))
set3 <- unique(na.omit(PAP1.VS.CONTROL.DOWN$Protein))
set4 <- unique(na.omit(PAP1.VS.CONTROL.UP$Protein))


# Create named list of sets
gene_sets <- list(
  ShK_DOWN  = set1,
  ShK_UP    = set2,
  PAP1_DOWN = set3,
  PAP1_UP   = set4
)

# Create presence-absence matrix
all_genes <- unique(unlist(gene_sets))

presence_matrix <- data.frame(
  Gene = all_genes,
  ShK_DOWN  = all_genes %in% set1,
  ShK_UP    = all_genes %in% set2,
  PAP1_DOWN = all_genes %in% set3,
  PAP1_UP   = all_genes %in% set4
)

# View or export the full overlap matrix
head(presence_matrix)
write.csv(presence_matrix, "4way_venn_overlap_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r PAP1.Resilience.venn for for Bulk RNAseq data}
library(VennDiagram)
library(readr)  # Ensure read_csv is available

# Read the data
VENN_JAN28 <- read_csv("~/Desktop/SnRNAseq.manuscript.Plots.April10/PAP1.vs.Control.plots/VENN.JAN28.csv")
# Define the input sets
venn.list <- list(
  PAP1.UP = head(VENN_JAN28$PAP1.UP, 212),
  PAP1.DOWN = head(VENN_JAN28$PAP1.DOWN, 175),
  Pro.Resilience = head(VENN_JAN28$Pro.Resilience.Mouse, 299),
  Anti.Resilience = head(VENN_JAN28$`Anti-Resilience.Mouse`, 216)
)

# Create the Venn diagram
venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = venn.list,
  category.names = c("PAP1.UP", "PAP1.DOWN", "Pro.Resilience", "Anti-Resilience"),
  fill = c("skyblue", "lightgoldenrod1", "orchid", "salmon"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex = 2.5,
  cat.cex = 1.5,
  cat.col = c("blue4", "darkorange3", "purple4", "red3"),
  filename = NULL  # Direct plotting
)

# Render the diagram
grid::grid.draw(venn.plot)
```

```{r PAP1 Shk Resilience study}
#WGCNA 
library(writexl)
library(WGCNA)
# Ensure WGCNA settings
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
allowWGCNAThreads()  # Enables parallel computation for WGCNA
# Function to compute Module Eigengenes (MEs)
compute_MEs <- function(count_data) {
  if (!exists("count_data") || nrow(count_data) == 0) {
    stop("Error: count_data is empty or not found. Check gene filtering!")
  }
  
  # Remove rows with any NA values
  count_data <- count_data[complete.cases(count_data), ]
  
  if (nrow(count_data) == 0) {
    stop("Error: All genes were removed after NA filtering. Check data!")
  }
  
  # Transpose so genes are columns, samples are rows
  datExpr <- t(count_data)
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)
  
  # Ensure minimum variance for module calculation
  if (ncol(datExpr) < 2) {
    stop("Error: Too few genes to compute eigengenes. Check input!")
  }

  # Assign all genes to a single module
  module_colors <- rep("Module1", ncol(datExpr))

  # Compute Module Eigengenes
  MEs <- tryCatch({
    moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing Module Eigengenes: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(list(MEs = MEs, datExpr = datExpr))  # Return both MEs and transformed data
}

# Ensure input data exists
if (!exists("mito_counts") || !exists("synaptic_counts") || !exists("ribosomal_counts")) {
  stop("Error: One or more count datasets (mito_counts, synaptic_counts, ribosomal_counts) are missing!")
}

if (!exists("mitochondrial.Pro.resilience") || !exists("synaptic.Pro.resilience") || !exists("ribosomes.Pro.resilience")) {
  stop("Error: One or more gene lists (mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, synaptic.Pro.resilience, ribosomes.Pro.resilience) are missing!")
}

# Compute MEs for each gene set (store transformed expression data too)
MEs_mito <- compute_MEs(mito_counts[rownames(mito_counts) %in% mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, , drop = FALSE])
MEs_synaptic <- compute_MEs(synaptic_counts[rownames(synaptic_counts) %in% synaptic.Pro.resilience, ,drop = FALSE])

# Function to compute kME values
compute_kME <- function(datExpr, MEs) {
  if (nrow(datExpr) == 0) {
    stop("Error: datExpr is empty. Check gene filtering!")
  }
  if (nrow(MEs$MEs) == 0) {
    stop("Error: MEs are empty. Eigengene computation may have failed.")
  }

  # Ensure column names match
  colnames(MEs$MEs) <- paste0("ME", colnames(MEs$MEs))
  
  kMEdat <- tryCatch({
    signedKME(datExpr, MEs$MEs, outputColumnName = "kME_")
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing kME: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(kMEdat)
}

# Compute kME for each gene set

kME_synaptic <- compute_kME(MEs_synaptic$datExpr, MEs_synaptic)
kME_ribosomal <- compute_kME(MEs_ribosomal$datExpr, MEs_ribosomal)

# Save kME tables to Excel

write_xlsx(list(
  Mitochondrial = as.data.frame(kME_mito),
  Synaptic = as.data.frame(kME_synaptic),
  Ribosomal = as.data.frame(kME_ribosomal)
), output_file)
```

```{r modified boxplot resilience}
#Boxplot Function With ANOVA + t-tests
create_boxplot <- function(data, title) {
  ymax <- max(data$Eigengene, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggboxplot(data, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene", fill = "Treatment", 
            palette = group_colors) +
    # ANOVA: overall comparison, displayed higher than pairwise
    stat_compare_means(method = "anova", label.y = ymax * 1.2, size = 4.5) +
    
    # Pairwise t-tests
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", 
                       comparisons = comparisons, size = 4) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

p_synapse <- create_boxplot(MEs_synapse_df, "Synaptic Resilience")
p_ribo <- create_boxplot(MEs_ribo_df, "Ribosomal Resilience")

print(p_mito)
```

```{r Interferon MEs}
#WGCNA 
library(writexl)
library(WGCNA)
# Ensure WGCNA settings
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
allowWGCNAThreads()  # Enables parallel computation for WGCNA
# Function to compute Module Eigengenes (MEs)
compute_MEs <- function(count_data) {
  if (!exists("count_data") || nrow(count_data) == 0) {
    stop("Error: count_data is empty or not found. Check gene filtering!")
  }
  
  # Remove rows with any NA values
  count_data <- count_data[complete.cases(count_data), ]
  
  if (nrow(count_data) == 0) {
    stop("Error: All genes were removed after NA filtering. Check data!")
  }
  
  # Transpose so genes are columns, samples are rows
  datExpr <- t(count_data)
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)
  
  # Ensure minimum variance for module calculation
  if (ncol(datExpr) < 2) {
    stop("Error: Too few genes to compute eigengenes. Check input!")
  }

  # Assign all genes to a single module
  module_colors <- rep("Module1", ncol(datExpr))

  # Compute Module Eigengenes
  MEs <- tryCatch({
    moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing Module Eigengenes: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(list(MEs = MEs, datExpr = datExpr))  # Return both MEs and transformed data
}

    stop("Error: MEs are empty. Eigengene computation may have failed.")
  }

  # Ensure column names match
  colnames(MEs$MEs) <- paste0("ME", colnames(MEs$MEs))
  
  kMEdat <- tryCatch({
    signedKME(datExpr, MEs$MEs, outputColumnName = "kME_")
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing kME: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(kMEdat)
}
```

```{r create_boxplot() function to accept custom comparisons}
create_boxplot <- function(data, title, comparisons) {
  p <- ggboxplot(data, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene", fill = "Treatment", 
                 palette = condition_colors) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", comparisons = comparisons) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene")
  
  # Add ANOVA only if more than two groups
  if (length(unique(data$Treatment)) > 2) {
    p <- p + stat_compare_means(method = "anova", 
                                 label.y = max(data$Eigengene, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1)
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r ME box plot for Anti.resilience}
Anti.Resilience.Mouse <- readRDS("~/Desktop/GO.Kv1.3.Proteomics/Anti.Resilience.Mouse.rds")
# Extract gene symbols from rownames (strip off everything after "_")

# Filter using gene symbols for each category

rownames(Anti.Resilience_counts) <- gene_symbols[gene_symbols %in% Anti.Resilience.Mouse]

dim(Anti.Resilience_counts)

#WGCNA 
library(writexl)
library(WGCNA)
# Ensure WGCNA settings
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
allowWGCNAThreads()  # Enables parallel computation for WGCNA
# Function to compute Module Eigengenes (MEs)
compute_MEs <- function(count_data) {
  if (!exists("count_data") || nrow(count_data) == 0) {
    stop("Error: count_data is empty or not found. Check gene filtering!")
  }
  
  # Remove rows with any NA values
  count_data <- count_data[complete.cases(count_data), ]
  
  if (nrow(count_data) == 0) {
    stop("Error: All genes were removed after NA filtering. Check data!")
  }
  
  # Transpose so genes are columns, samples are rows
  datExpr <- t(count_data)
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)
  
  # Ensure minimum variance for module calculation
  if (ncol(datExpr) < 2) {
    stop("Error: Too few genes to compute eigengenes. Check input!")
  }

  # Assign all genes to a single module
  module_colors <- rep("Module1", ncol(datExpr))

  # Compute Module Eigengenes
  MEs <- tryCatch({
    moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing Module Eigengenes: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(list(MEs = MEs, datExpr = datExpr))  # Return both MEs and transformed data
}

# Ensure input data exists
if (!exists("mito_counts") || !exists("synaptic_counts") || !exists("ribosomal_counts")) {
  stop("Error: One or more count datasets (mito_counts, synaptic_counts, ribosomal_counts) are missing!")
}

if (!exists("mitochondrial.Pro.resilience") || !exists("synaptic.Pro.resilience") || !exists("ribosomes.Pro.resilience")) {
  stop("Error: One or more gene lists (mitochondrial.Pro.resilience, synaptic.Pro.resilience, ribosomes.Pro.resilience) are missing!")
}



# Function to compute kME values
compute_kME <- function(datExpr, MEs) {
  if (nrow(datExpr) == 0) {
    stop("Error: datExpr is empty. Check gene filtering!")
  }
  if (nrow(MEs$MEs) == 0) {
    stop("Error: MEs are empty. Eigengene computation may have failed.")
  }

  # Ensure column names match
  colnames(MEs$MEs) <- paste0("ME", colnames(MEs$MEs))
  
  kMEdat <- tryCatch({
    signedKME(datExpr, MEs$MEs, outputColumnName = "kME_")
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing kME: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(kMEdat)
}

# Compute kME for each gene set

# Extract gene symbols from rownames
gene_symbols_Anti.Resilience <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(Anti.Resilience_counts))

# Filter mito_counts based on gene symbols
filtered.Anti.Resilience_counts <- Anti.Resilience_counts[gene_symbols_Anti.Resilience %in% Anti.Resilience.Mouse, , drop = FALSE]

# Optional: set clean rownames
rownames(filtered.Anti.Resilience_counts) <- gene_symbols_Anti.Resilience[gene_symbols_Anti.Resilience %in% Anti.Resilience.Mouse]

# Check dimensions to confirm it worked
dim(filtered.Anti.Resilience_counts)
```

```{r Mitocarta based ME ANALYSIS}
# Load libraries
library(readr)

# Extract gene symbols from rownames
gene_symbols <- sub("_.*", "", rownames(KV1.3.BULK.BRAIN.PRoteomics.normalized))

# Filter expression data for Mitocarta genes
Mouse_Mitocarta_counts <- KV1.3.BULK.BRAIN.PRoteomics.normalized[gene_symbols %in% Mouse_Mitocarta$MitoCarta, , drop = FALSE]

# --- Compute Module Eigengenes ---
compute_MEs <- function(count_data) {
  if (nrow(count_data) == 0) stop("Error: count_data is empty or not found.")
  count_data <- count_data[complete.cases(count_data), ]
  if (nrow(count_data) == 0) stop("Error: All genes removed after NA filtering.")
  
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(t(count_data))
  if (ncol(datExpr) < 2) stop("Error: Too few genes to compute eigengenes.")
  
  module_colors <- rep("Module1", ncol(datExpr))
  
  MEs <- tryCatch({
    moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = module_colors)$eigengenes
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing Module Eigengenes: ", e$message)
  })
  
  list(MEs = MEs, datExpr = datExpr)
}

# --- Compute kME ---
compute_kME <- function(datExpr, MEs) {
  if (nrow(datExpr) == 0) stop("Error: datExpr is empty.")
  if (nrow(MEs$MEs) == 0) stop("Error: MEs are empty.")
  
  colnames(MEs$MEs) <- paste0("ME", colnames(MEs$MEs))
  
  kMEdat <- tryCatch({
    signedKME(datExpr, MEs$MEs, outputColumnName = "kME_")
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Error in computing kME: ", e$message)
  })
  
  return(kMEdat)
}

  ggboxplot(data, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene", fill = "Treatment", 
            palette = condition_colors) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "anova", label.y = max(data$Eigengene, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", comparisons = comparisons) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene")
}

# --- Generate Plot ---
p_Mitocarta <- create_boxplot(MEs_Mitocarta_df, "Mitocarta Genes")
p_Mitocarta

# Optionally save the plot
ggsave("Mitocarta_Eigengene_Boxplot.png", plot = p_Mitocarta, width = 6, height = 4)


####
create_boxplot <- function(data, title, comparisons) {
  p <- ggboxplot(data, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene", fill = "Treatment", 
                 palette = condition_colors) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", comparisons = comparisons) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Treatment", y = "Eigengene")
  
  # Add ANOVA only if more than two groups
  if (length(unique(data$Treatment)) > 2) {
    p <- p + stat_compare_means(method = "anova", 
                                 label.y = max(data$Eigengene, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1)
  }
  
  return(p)
}


#Subset the data for each comparison

# Subset for Pap1 vs Control
data_Pap1_vs_Control <- subset(MEs_Mitocarta_df, Treatment %in% c("Pap1", "Control"))

# Subset for SHK vs PBS
data_SHK_vs_PBS <- subset(MEs_Mitocarta_df, Treatment %in% c("SHK", "PBS"))

#Define comparisons for each subset
comparisons_Pap1_vs_Control <- list(c("Pap1", "Control"))
comparisons_SHK_vs_PBS <- list(c("SHK", "PBS"))

#Generate the boxplots
p_Pap1_vs_Control <- create_boxplot(data_Pap1_vs_Control, "Pap1 vs Control:MitoCarta", comparisons_Pap1_vs_Control)
p_SHK_vs_PBS <- create_boxplot(data_SHK_vs_PBS, "SHK vs PBS:MitoCarta", comparisons_SHK_vs_PBS)

# View plots
p_Pap1_vs_Control
p_SHK_vs_PBS
```
